en: A black‑and‑white image showing a small rural church complex behind stone walls and trees. The main building has a steeply pitched roof with a cross on the ridge and simple rectangular windows. To the right stands a separate wooden bell tower with a distinctively shaped, tiered roof. In the foreground are low stone walls, a dirt road, and neatly laid garden paths leading toward the churchyard.
